many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Recover the 4x4 patch of 3s from its 180-degree-symmetric counterpart."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    if not cells:
        raise ValueError("No 3-colored patch found")
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][len(grid[0]) - 1 - c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
}
